alert.summary: CloudWatch alarm fired for ECS service checkout

root_cause.hypothesis: checkout containers OOMKilled: app allocates ~900MiB cache on startup but memory_limit_mib=48 (way undersized), causing OOM kill -> CrashLoopBackOff on both pods. Not a deploy regression (no recent deploys listed) - looks like a config/limit mismatch or pre-existing bug exposed by memory pressure.

ruled_out: New deploy causing regression (deploy list empty)

proposal.reasoning: Root cause: memory_limit_mib=48 vs ~900MiB startup cache alloc, config mismatch not deploy regression. No listed action fixes container memory limit (task def edit needed). restart_pods = same crashloop immediately, no gain. scale_up (task count) doesn't raise per-task memory limit.
proposal.expected_effect: none from automation; human raises checkout task memory_limit_mib (>=1024) and redeploys/updates task def to stop OOM crashloop
